items.headline: $OSMO Freezes 84K Wallets After Web3Auth Breach
items.summary: Osmosis pushed a validator patch restricting 84,000 wallets to recovery-only transfers after a Web3Auth breach, freezing 64 accounts linked to the attacker.

items.headline: Ansem Wallet Drain Sends $BULL Crashing 55%
items.summary: A $2.57M drain hit Ansem-linked Bullpen beta accounts, and the Black Bull creator coin $BULL plunged 55% as Ansem denied involvement.

items.headline: $EUL Shakeup: Euler Technologies Replaces Labs
items.summary: Euler is swapping its dev shop, with Euler Technologies taking over the app and protocol development as admin permissions transfer by end of November.

items.headline: $SEI v6.8 Preps Giga With Contract Kill Switch
items.summary: Sei's mandatory v6.8 mainnet upgrade removes legacy Cosmos modules and adds CosmWasm contract-shutdown controls ahead of the Giga upgrade.

items.headline: Gemini Enables Shielded $ZEC Deposits
items.summary: Gemini now lets customers deposit $ZEC directly into shielded addresses via Ironwood, expanding privacy-preserving support for Zcash.
